title: Air Conditioner Maintenance in Castle Hills, TX
desc: If you need air conditioner maintenance in Castle Hills, TX, call the Rosenberg experts today to schedule service. We have AC tune-up plans!

blocks.text: Castle Hills is a pleasant enclave of San Antonio. However, everyone who lives here admits that Bexar County can be both hot and humid in the summer. You need a dependable air conditioning company to keep your home’s cooling system in top shape. Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has a team of trained and experienced professionals in Castle Hills, TX who will do just that. Our company was founded in 2003 by two families with heating and cooling experience. Over the years, we’ve kept up with all the technical improvements in the home-cooling industry. We make sure our technicians are trained and experienced before they show up at your home. Our team knows how to keep your AC operating in peak condition, and they’re dedicated to doing just that.

blocks.text: Your home’s cooling system is a major and very important investment. Yet it needs to be functioning correctly in order to maintain your family’s health and comfort. Regular AC maintenance for your cooling equipment will also extend the life of the system and save you money on fixes down the road. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air we have what we call a Comfort Club for Castle Hills clients. We’d like for you to join it and enjoy the benefits.

Our routine air conditioner maintenance is a detailed 18-point checklist that assures the efficient operation of your cooling system. It includes an inspection of all electrical and moving parts, a refrigerant check and cleaning of coils, condensers and filters. Before the start of the warm weather, we make sure your AC equipment is up for the job. Once we do, it will run more efficiently and cost less to operate.

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’re passionate about making sure that your family is healthy and comfortable in your Castle Hills home. Regular AC maintenance contributes to good air quality, lower utility bills, reduced repair costs and extending equipment life. Our family-run business has built a strong customer base in this area by delivering reliable, skilled customer service for decades. You can read our clients’ testimonials on our website. Call us today to find out why your neighbors have made us their go-to air conditioner maintenance company.
Not looking for AC maintenance? We also offer AC installation and AC repair, as well as heating maintenance.
